llm.summary: This is a disclosed local vocabulary-learning skill that stores and can modify its own word lists, with no hidden network, credential, or system-level behavior found.

dimensions.detail: Runtime file access is limited to fixed skill-managed JSON files under the artifact data directory, with no broad filesystem indexing or external service access.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No install hooks, dependency installation, remote payload retrieval, autostart setup, or tool replacement behavior was found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill asks the agent to apply bilingual learning behavior when the skill is used; that is purpose-aligned but should remain subordinate to higher-priority formatting, safety, and user language instructions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill persists vocabulary/configuration locally and exposes add, delete, transfer, list, and clear operations; the clear path lacks confirmation and selector validation, but it is constrained to skill-owned word-list files.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated CN-to-EN passive learning purpose matches the local word-library, quiz, and randomization components, though the code is mostly utility support rather than a complete final-output transformation engine.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this only if you want an agent skill that may mix bilingual learning prompts into responses and keep local vocabulary records. Back up the word-list files before using clear/delete operations, and do not enable the skill for tasks requiring exact output formats or single-language responses.
llm.findings:
[TP4] expected: The documentation and code are not perfectly aligned on final-output processing, but the vocabulary libraries, quizzes, and dice utility are disclosed parts of the learning workflow rather than hidden unrelated authority.
[SQP-3] expected: Fixed CN-to-EN bilingual behavior is central to this skill and is disclosed; users should avoid enabling it where exact single-language or strict JSON output is required.
[SDI-1] expected: The CLI and word-library management functions are documented in both SKILL.md and README.md, so they are not undeclared capability drift.
[SDI-2] expected: State-changing vocabulary operations are expected for a local learning word bank, though destructive clear/delete commands would benefit from stronger confirmation and validation.
[LP3] expected: Persistent local storage is expected for a vocabulary-learning tool and is described in the artifact; no broad permission request or privileged access was found.
[SQP-2] expected: The skill describes adding unknown words to a local word library, and the code only stores local vocabulary data; users should still treat this as personal learning-profile data.
[SDI-4] expected: The standalone dice script is disclosed and only provides local random selection/demonstration behavior.
[T09] unexpected: The static finding is valid as a low-risk local data-loss bug: malformed selectors can silently target the known-word library for clear/delete/list behavior, but the affected paths remain fixed to skill-managed JSON files.
